text:
Situation: Azithromycin tablets from Pfizer Inc. are listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-04-09. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 56 months. Corvale East holds 347 units at 31.2 units per day (11 days on hand). Corvale General holds 702 units at 31.7 units per day (22 days on hand). Current stock: Corvale East 250 mg 227 units (14.7 days), 500 mg 120 units (7.6 days); Corvale General 333.62 units (20.9 days) and 368.83 units (23.4 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Pfizer Inc. azithromycin tablets as To Be Discontinued since 2026-04-09. The label for NDC 71205067403 names Proficient Rx LP as product labeler and plant with RELABEL and REPACK operations and a last inspection classification of VAI on 2022-12-08. FDA inspection 1194148 of Proficient Rx LP ended 2022-12-08 and was classified VAI; the classification letter was issued 2023-02-08, 289 days after the shortage posting on 2022-02-22.

Our position: Supply at both sites is below 30 days. Pfizer product is discontinued per FDA record. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with A-S Medication Solutions; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
